brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a single finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail for バスケまとめ.
Create ONE new original landscape PNG, 1600x900 preferred, exactly or approximately 16:9, width at least 1000px. Fully opaque.

Approved visual direction: deep near-black #151A18 background, vivid lime #CCF43B, warm off-white lettering, orange basketball. Bold Japanese headline typography, hand-drawn brush-and-ink illustration with confident scratchy black contours and expressive broad lime brush strokes. Strong, restrained editorial poster, few elements, very legible at thumbnail size. Clearly illustrated, never photorealistic. The approved style reference viewed in context shows this black/lime palette, bold type, and expressive ink: use its visual language ONLY, not its player, name, statistics, date, pose or exact composition.

Subject: exactly one REAL basketball player, D.J. Hogg (ディー・ジェイ・ホグ), chosen because he is the main player discussed in the supplied article. Carefully base his likeness on the official Alvark Tokyo player profile images viewed in context: light medium warm skin, short close-cropped dark brown curly hair with slightly higher textured top, short faded sides, rounded-rectangular oval face, strong eyebrows and deep-set brown eyes, fairly straight medium-width nose, neatly trimmed dark full jaw beard connected to a mustache, solid athletic long-armed build. Do not use the Culver likeness from the style reference. Draw all of Hogg entirely by hand in ink, with facial features clearly visible and recognizable. No pasted photographic elements.

Composition: fresh dynamic layout, player dominates LEFT 43%, typography grouped on RIGHT 52%. Hogg in a three-quarter forward-facing catch-and-shoot gathering stance, slightly bent knees, leaning into an upward shooting movement, basketball held by both hands just above chest height, elbows naturally bent. Crop tastefully at mid-thigh at bottom, keep full head and both hands and whole basketball well within frame. Realistic hand anatomy and five fingers per hand, hands naturally wrapping basketball. This is an imagined basketball movement, NOT a recreation of the actual game or any specific shot. Generic plain black sleeveless jersey with small red edging and off-white ink highlights, NO jersey wording, NO jersey numbers, NO logos or sponsor marks. A lime brush swash runs diagonally behind the player, with subtle ink flecks. Keep the text area mostly calm dark. No opponents, extra human silhouettes, crowd, arena branding, trophy, or scoreboard.

Text: render ONLY the following exact Japanese strings, cleanly and accurately. Set all text on safe margins at least 5% from the edges. Keep the explanatory footer fully legible.
Small top header: "バスケまとめ"
Small date label: "11/14 試合結果"
Large white heading grouped on right: "A東京 3ポイント"
Largest centerpiece on right, rough bold lime numerals and white/lime Japanese: "21本成功"
Medium strong white match score below the centerpiece, one line: "A東京 99–83 広島"
Small but readable footer on a dark clear strip: "イラスト（AI生成）"
Next to that footer: "成績をもとにしたイメージ"

Editorial grounding: ONLY the frozen source.html and source.txt of job 9f757581f96bc573aa5f are the article facts. They say Alvark Tokyo beat Hiroshima 99-83 on November 14 and the TEAM made 21 three-pointers. Thus 21 must read unambiguously as the TEAM three-point total, NOT Hogg's personal figure. Do not add any other statistics or claims, do not label the game November 15, do not imply a game-winning shot. Use the November 15 article's central November 14 game. The official player site is solely for appearance reference, not article statistics.

Constraints: no team/league/sponsor/manufacturer logos, no official photographs incorporated, no photorealism, no invented player, no fake signature, no extra captions, no extra text, no clipped letters or face, no pasted photo collage. Preserve the exact AI label and illustration disclaimer. Finished professional one-image thumbnail.

qa_notes.inspection: 生成画像を実際に表示して目視確認。文字・数値・日付・顔の特徴・手・余白・見切れ・注記を確認。
qa_notes.text_and_numbers: A東京のチーム3ポイント21本成功、A東京99-83広島、11/14試合結果が固定原稿と一致。21本が個人成績に見えないようA東京3ポイントと一体配置。字形と数字を確認。プロンプトのen dashは生成画像では通常のハイフンに相当する表示で、スコアの意味は同一。
qa_notes.source_qualifiers: 11/15記事が主に扱う11/14の試合と明記。追記された別試合の数字とは混同しない。「成績をもとにしたイメージ」を表示し、決勝シュートなど特定場面の再現を主張していない。
qa_notes.likeness_or_no_named_person: 公式資料と髪型・眉・輪郭・鼻・口ひげ・顎ひげを比較。イラスト化による簡略化はあるがホグ選手の主要な特徴が反映されている。架空の別選手を追加していない。
qa_notes.layout: 横長1672x941（約16:9）。人物を左、文字を右に配置。頭・両手・ボール・文字・注記に見切れなし。左右の手の指とボールの関係に明瞭な破綻なし。下半身のみ意図したクロップ。ロゴやスポンサー表記なし。
